title: dPlayerProfiles
description: Profiles, achievements, badges, paths. All driven by YAML and in-game GUI. Exactly what you need for player retention.
body:
![dPlayerProfiles Cover Photo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba5dd69b52dedefefbe322e11045c6b7d9f619a0_0.webp) **dPlayerProfiles** gives every player a browsable profile packed with **achievements, badges, and a points progression path**. Everything is driven by simple YAML files with automatic tracking across **30+ trigger types**. Drop it in, define your content, and your players have a real reason to keep **coming back.** ![Features Header Photo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20d5bf5cfc8b071398e08d5aaf92b2b5ed30eebe.png) ✅Browsable player profiles with **achievement progress, badges, playtime, and login streak**
✅Achievement system with **30+ trigger types** covering vanilla gameplay and third-party plugins
✅**Badge collection** with chat hover integration and up to 3 pinnable badges per player
✅Points progression path with **per-node rewards** and milestone indicators
✅**Server leaderboard** ranked by achievements completed and badge count
✅Full **in-game reward editor** with no file editing required
✅**Anti-AFK** detection and CoreProtect anti-farm protection
✅SQLite and MySQL support
✅PlaceholderAPI support

**Integrations:** MythicMobs, mcMMO, AuraSkills, EliteMobs, Jobs Reborn, FluxShops, CrazyCrates, Duels, OneInTheChamberReborn, dTournaments, PinataParty, CoreProtect, PlaceholderAPI​
